title: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
title_zh: 总结原题翻译：PersonaCUABench：面向多元人设的计算机使用智能体基准测试

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are commonly evaluated against fixed task specifications, but users may omit requirements, add constraints, or require approval before consequential actions. Completing the benchmark instruction does not guarantee serving the person who asked. We introduce PersonaCUABench, which holds 74 tasks across 11 domains fixed and varies only who asks. A persona agent, playing one of 44 personas in four groups, rewrites each instruction in that user’s own words and answers the CUA’s questions, while the CUA sees only the dialogue, never the profile or the original instruction. Across nine backbones (3,330 runs), mean task completion falls by 36% relative to the original requests. The losses have two sources: in 59.9% of cells that lose points, the agent engages with what the user asked for and still gets it wrong, and 11.2% are stops the user requested that the checker scores as failures. Even when a persona request is fully completed, the user gives the top satisfaction rating in only 62.7% of cells, against 84.1% for the original requests. CUAs should therefore be evaluated not only on task completion but also on whether they meet the requirements and constraints users express.

paragraphs.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) increasingly perform multi-step tasks in web browsers and desktop applications, from gathering information to making reservations and sending messages ( Garg et al., 2025 ) . Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents complete predefined tasks ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , including increasingly challenging long-horizon settings ( Jang et al., 2026b ; Yuan et al., 2026 ) . In real-world use, however, users may express goals incompletely, introduce personal constraints, or request confirmation before consequential actions. Satisfying a predefined task specification can therefore differ from serving the person who made the request. A fixed specification cannot reveal this gap, which raises our question: when different people ask a CUA for the same task in their own words, does it serve each of them, or only the task?
paragraphs.zh: 计算机使用智能体（CUA）越来越多地在网页浏览器和桌面应用中执行多步骤任务，从收集信息到预订和发送消息（Garg et al., 2025）。 现有基准主要评估智能体是否完成预定义任务（Zhou et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024），包括越来越具挑战性的长时程设定（Jang et al., 2026b；Yuan et al., 2026）。 然而，在真实使用中，用户可能不完整地表达目标、引入个人约束，或在执行有重大影响的操作前请求确认。 因此，满足预定义的任务规范可能不同于服务于提出请求的那个人。 固定的规范无法揭示这一差距，由此引出我们的问题：当不同的人用自己的话向 CUA 请求同一任务时，它是服务于每一个人，还是只服务于任务本身？

sents.en: A fixed specification cannot reveal this gap, which raises our question: when different people ask a CUA for the same task in their own words, does it serve each of them, or only the task?
sents.zh: 固定的规范无法揭示这一差距，由此引出我们的问题：当不同的人用自己的话向 CUA 请求同一任务时，它是服务于每一个人，还是只服务于任务本身？

paragraphs.en: Serving the person is harder than completing a fixed specification. The agent must infer what the user leaves unsaid and judge when to ask or confirm before acting, and for a CUA these judgments are consequential: a misread request can mean money spent, an email sent, or more disclosed than the user intended ( Goel and Gurevych, 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ) . Success is also user-dependent. An agent that drafts an offer and stops may fail a checker written for sending it, yet do exactly what a cautious user asked. Completing the specified task and serving the person can thus come apart, so an evaluation of CUAs needs to measure both.
paragraphs.zh: 服务于人比完成一份固定的规格说明更难。 智能体必须推断用户没有明说的内容，并在行动前判断何时该询问或确认，而对计算机操作智能体（CUA）而言，这些判断事关重大：误解请求可能意味着花掉了钱、发出了邮件，或者泄露了超出用户本意的信息（Goel and Gurevych, 2026；Hu et al., 2026）。 成功与否也取决于用户。 一个起草了报价但停下来的智能体，在为「发送报价」编写的检查者看来可能算失败，但它却恰恰做到了一个谨慎用户所要求的事。 因此，完成指定任务与服务于人可能彼此分离，所以对 CUA 的评估需要同时衡量两者。

paragraphs.en: Prior work makes agents personal by giving the agent stored information about the user: a logged profile, a long-term history, or a logged-in environment ( Cai et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Jang et al., 2026a ) . We give the agent no profile. It learns who the user is only from the request and from the user’s answers to its questions. Each user is built from attributes of the MatrAIx persona schema ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Holding the task fixed and changing only who asks isolates the effect of who is asking.
paragraphs.zh: 已有研究通过为智能体提供关于用户的存储信息来使智能体个性化：记录的画像、长期历史或登录环境（Cai et al., 2025；Kim et al., 2026；Jang et al., 2026a）。 我们不给智能体任何画像。 它只能从请求本身以及用户对其问题的回答中了解用户是谁。 每个用户由 MatrAIx 人设模式（Li et al., 2026）的属性构建而成。 保持任务固定而仅改变提问者，从而隔离出「谁在提问」的影响。

paragraphs.en: We introduce PersonaCUABench (Figure 1 ), built around a persona-conditioned request protocol: a persona agent is given a profile and the original instruction, writes the opening request in that person’s own words, and answers the CUA’s clarifying questions in character, so the CUA works only from the dialogue. The tasks come from existing benchmarks so that outcomes stay independently checkable: information tasks on live websites and action tasks on sandboxed replicas of real sites, across everyday and work scenarios in 11 domains. Each task is asked by the four personas of its domain, one per group ( expert , senior , young , practical ), and by an original request that passes the instruction unchanged, without a persona. Because a request can leave requirements unsaid, we score whether the user raised each requirement, whether the agent engaged with it, and whether it was met, and we report this diagnosis alongside task completion and the user’s own satisfaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 PersonaCUABench（图 1），其核心是角色条件化的请求协议：一个角色智能体获得一份角色档案和原始指令，以该人物的口吻撰写开场请求，并以其身份回答 CUA（计算机使用智能体）提出的澄清问题，从而让 CUA 仅凭对话来完成任务。 任务来自现有基准，因此结果仍可被独立核查：包括真实网站上的信息类任务，以及真实网站沙盒复刻环境上的操作类任务，覆盖 11 个领域中的日常生活与工作场景。 每个任务由其所属领域的四个角色分别提出，每个小组一个角色（专家、资深者、年轻人、实用主义者），此外还包含一个不做角色设定、原样传递指令的原始请求。 由于请求可能未明说某些需求，我们评估用户是否提出了每项需求、智能体是否回应了该需求，以及该需求是否被满足，并将这一诊断结果与任务完成情况和用户自身的满意度一并报告。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating nine backbones in one shared browser harness, we find that a persona-phrased request lowers average task completion from 0.689 to 0.441 with every backbone losing between 28% and 45%. The diagnosis locates two sources of this loss: in 59.9% of the cells that lose points the agent engages with what the user raised yet still gets a requirement wrong, while another 11.2% are stops the user asked for that the original checker counts as failures. We further find that task completion and user satisfaction diverge in both directions and that, on GPT-6 Astra, neither revealing the user’s profile nor requiring a clarification question is sufficient to recover the loss in task completion. PersonaCUABench thus provides a controlled testbed for personal CUAs: it compares different personas on the same tasks, diagnoses how user requirements are handled, and measures task completion and user satisfaction.

paragraphs.en: The goal of a personal computer-use agent is to serve the person who made the request. We make this precise by formalizing the three stages of Figure 1 : who asks for a task (Stage 1, § 2.1 ), how the user and the agent interact (Stage 2, § 2.2 ), and how the outcome is scored (Stage 3, § 2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 个人计算机使用智能体的目标是服务于提出请求的人。 我们通过形式化图1的三个阶段来精确阐述这一点：谁提出任务（阶段1，§2.1），用户与智能体如何交互（阶段2，§2.2），以及结果如何评分（阶段3，§2.3）。

sents.en: The goal of a personal computer-use agent is to serve the person who made the request.
sents.zh: 个人计算机使用智能体的目标是服务于提出请求的人。

sents.en: We make this precise by formalizing the three stages of Figure 1 : who asks for a task (Stage 1, § 2.1 ), how the user and the agent interact (Stage 2, § 2.2 ), and how the outcome is scored (Stage 3, § 2.3 ).

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 starts from a task and decides who asks for it. Each task t t , taken from an existing benchmark whose outcome can be checked automatically, is a triple ( x t , ℛ t , C t ) , \bigl(x_{t},\;\mathcal{R}_{t},\;C_{t}\bigr), where x t x_{t} is the original instruction of that benchmark, ℛ t = { r t , 1 , … , r t , n t } \mathcal{R}_{t}=\{r_{t,1},\dots,r_{t,n_{t}}\} its set of requirements, and C t C_{t} its evaluation procedure, both defined in § 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段从一项任务开始，并决定由谁来提出请求。 每个任务 t t（取自一个其结果可被自动验证的现有基准）是一个三元组 ( x t , ℛ t , C t ) , \bigl(x_{t},\;\mathcal{R}_{t},\;C_{t}\bigr)，其中 x t x_{t} 是该基准的原始指令，ℛ t = { r t , 1 , … , r t , n t } \mathcal{R}_{t}=\{r_{t,1},\dots,r_{t,n_{t}}\} 是其需求集合，C t C_{t} 是其评估流程，两者均在 § 2.3 中定义。

paragraphs.en: We draw tasks from two recent benchmarks that together cover what users ask computer-use agents to do: find information and take actions. Odysseys ( Jang et al., 2026b ) provides long-horizon information tasks on live websites, in which the agent gathers, compares, and reports information. REAL provides action tasks on deterministic replicas of widely used websites, such as ordering food, sending an email, or booking a stay. Both remain hard for current agents, whose best results complete fewer than half of the tasks, and both check outcomes without a human: a rubric judge that never sees the dialogue scores Odysseys, and a programmatic check of the final site state scores REAL. Task completion therefore stays comparable across users who phrase the same task differently. From the two sources we keep tasks that run reproducibly in our harness and leave room for different users to want different things, dropping pure navigation, sites that block automated access, and duplicates (Appendix A.1 ). As shown in Table 1 , this leaves 74 tasks, 38 information and 36 action, drawn as subsets of the 200 Odysseys and 112 REAL tasks and spread across 11 domains and two scenarios (40 life and 34 work). Figure 1 (top) shows how they spread over the domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从两个近期的基准测试中抽取任务，它们共同覆盖了用户要求计算机使用智能体去做的事情：查找信息和执行操作。 Odysseys（Jang et al., 2026b）在真实网站上提供长时程信息任务，智能体在其中收集、比较并汇报信息。 REAL 在广泛使用的网站的确定性复制品上提供操作任务，例如点餐、发送电子邮件或预订住宿。 这两个基准对当前智能体而言仍然很难，其最佳结果完成不到一半的任务，并且两者都在无人工参与的情况下检查结果：Odysseys 由一个从不查看对话的评分准则裁判打分，REAL 则通过程序化检查最终网站状态来评分。 因此，对于以不同措辞表达同一任务的不同用户，任务完成度保持可比。 从这两个来源中，我们保留了能在我们的测试框架中可复现运行、并给不同用户留出想要不同结果空间的任务，剔除了纯导航类任务、阻止自动化访问的网站以及重复任务（附录 A.1）。 如表 1 所示，这留下了 74 个任务，其中 38 个信息任务和 36 个操作任务，分别是 200 个 Odysseys 任务和 112 个 REAL 任务的子集，分布在 11 个领域和两种场景中（40 个生活场景和 34 个工作场景）。 图 1（上）展示了这些任务在各领域中的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Each persona is described by 37 attributes selected from the 1,290-dimensional MatrAIx schema: 32 general attributes shared by all personas and five specific attributes chosen per domain (Figure 1 , Step 2, shows one senior profile). paragraphs.en: Section 4.2 showed that every model loses about a third of its task completion when a persona makes the request. We examine this loss through a case study and three analyses: § 5.1 compares task completion with the users’ own satisfaction; § 5.2 traces where the drop comes from; and § 5.3 tests whether showing the user’s profile or requiring the agent to ask a clarification question recovers the loss. paragraphs.en: The previous subsection shows how users perceive the results. To trace how the drop arises, we take the 1,230 loss cells, the persona cells that score below the original request on the same task and backbone, and give each one a primary cause. A cell that ends without the final submission is a stop, either one the user asked for by requesting a draft, a review, or to finish the action themselves, or one the agent made on its own. For every other cell we look at the requirements it lost and take the earliest break between the user and the outcome. The user may never have raised the requirement, the agent may not have engaged with a requirement the user raised, or the agent may have engaged with it and still not met it. Figure 5 shows the shares.
paragraphs.zh: 上一小节展示了用户如何感知这些结果。 为了追踪这一下降是如何产生的，我们取 1,230 个损失单元格（即在相同任务和相同骨干模型下，得分低于原始请求的角色单元格），并为每个单元格标注一个主要原因。 一个在没有最终提交的情况下结束的单元格就是一次停止，要么是用户要求的（例如要求起草、评审或自己完成该操作），要么是智能体自行做出的。 对于其他每个单元格，我们考察其丢失的需求，并找出用户与结果之间最早出现的断裂点。 可能是用户从未提出该需求，可能是智能体未处理用户提出的需求，也可能是智能体处理了该需求却仍未满足它。 图 5 展示了各占比情况。

paragraphs.en: Intervention 2: Forcing the agent to ask. When the agent must ask before it acts, every cell contains a question, yet task completion on persona requests does not recover, moving from 0.434 to 0.421. On action tasks with the original request the extra question even lowers task completion from 0.583 to 0.472, because the persona agent answers with constraints absent from the instruction. paragraphs.en: PersonalWAB ( Cai et al., 2025 ) gives the agent the profiles and behavior histories of 1,000 users for personalized search and recommendation. Persona2Web ( Kim et al., 2026 ) uses the browsing histories of 50 users to resolve ambiguous queries. Benchmarks for language models likewise condition on profiles, histories, or stated preferences ( Salemi et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2025a ; Zhao et al., 2025b ) , and model answers get worse for some groups of users ( Poole-Dayan et al., 2026 ) . PrefDisco ( Li et al., 2025 ) assigns ten personas to each reasoning problem and finds that models ask only 1.42 questions on average within five turns. Other benchmarks test whether agents ask about vague or underspecified instructions ( Qian et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Zhang et al., 2024b ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , including those of older adults ( Zhan et al., 2026 ) . These works study how an agent obtains user information. We record for each requirement whether it was raised, engaged, and met, and find that most loss cells arise after the agent has the information.

paragraphs.en: PersonaCUABench poses the same computer-use tasks for different users, and persona requests lower task completion from 0.689 to 0.441 across nine backbones. Most loss cells arise after the agent has engaged with what the user raised, and another 11.2% are stops the user asked for that the checker scores as failures. A fixed specification thus conflates how well the agent executes with how far the user’s request departs from it. On GPT-6 Astra, neither showing the profile nor requiring a question closes the gap: the bottleneck is carrying what the user said through a long sequence of actions. As completion and satisfaction also diverge, personal CUAs should be judged against the user’s request and from the user’s side, with simulated users validated against real ones.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaCUABench 为不同用户设置了相同的计算机使用任务，引入人格设定后，九个骨干模型的任务完成率从 0.689 降至 0.441。 大多数损失单元出现在智能体已经就用户提出的内容进行交互之后，另有 11.2% 是用户主动要求的中止，却被检查器判为失败。 因此，固定的规格说明把智能体的执行能力与用户请求偏离该规格的程度混为一谈。 在 GPT-6 Astra 上，无论是展示用户画像还是要求提问，都无法消除这一差距：瓶颈在于将用户所说的内容贯穿于长序列的操作之中。 由于完成率与满意度也会出现分歧，个人化智能体应当对照用户的请求、从用户的立场来评价，并以真实用户来验证模拟用户。

paragraphs.en: PersonaCUABench spans 11 domains drawn from everyday and work settings and evaluates nine general-purpose backbones in a shared browser harness. Its tasks focus on finding information and taking actions on websites, leaving desktop applications, standalone chat, and coding workflows outside its scope. Each episode begins with a single request and focuses on one task, whereas personal agents in real-world use can accumulate knowledge about their users across interactions. Future extensions could evaluate repeated interactions with persistent user memory and extend the intervention study to additional backbones.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaCUABench 涵盖取自日常和工作场景的 11 个领域，并在同一浏览器测试环境中评估九个通用骨干模型。 其任务聚焦于在网站上查找信息和执行操作，而将桌面应用程序、独立聊天和编码工作流排除在其范围之外。 每个回合以单个请求开始，并聚焦于一个任务，而现实使用中的智能体可以在多次交互中积累关于其用户的知识。 未来的扩展可以评估具有持久用户记忆的重复交互，并将干预研究扩展到更多骨干模型。

paragraphs.en: PersonaCUABench uses constructed personas and LLM-simulated users. Information tasks access live websites, while action tasks run on sandboxed replicas to avoid real-world transactions or communications. We acknowledge that persona construction may encode stereotypes and cannot capture the full diversity within demographic groups. Accordingly, performance differences should not be generalized to real populations, and simulated satisfaction ratings cannot replace feedback from real users. Our benchmark aims to improve user-aligned evaluation and highlights the importance of respecting user intent and obtaining authorization before consequential actions.
paragraphs.zh: PersonaCUABench 使用构建的人物画像和由大语言模型模拟的用户。 信息类任务访问真实网站，而操作类任务在沙盒化的副本上运行，以避免真实的交易或通信。 我们承认，人物画像的构建可能包含刻板印象，且无法捕捉人口群体内部的全部分差异性。 因此，性能差异不应被推广到真实人群，模拟的满意度评分也不能替代真实用户的反馈。 我们的任务基准旨在改进以用户为中心的对齐评估，并强调在进行有重大影响的操作前尊重用户意图并获得授权的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Odysseys contains 200 live-web tasks and REAL 112 tasks on replicas of 11 websites. To analyze intent on these tasks, we derive the requirements that each checker tests from the task manifest and the checker’s code (e.g., “the order includes a pizza” and “the order total is under $30”), phrase them as what the user wants, and review them by hand. These 107 requirements serve the intent measures of § 2.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个真实（REAL）任务包含一条指令和一个通过/不通过检查器。 为了分析这些任务中的意图，我们从任务清单和检查器的代码中推导出每个检查器所测试的要求（例如「订单包含一份披萨」和「订单总额低于 30 美元」），将其表述为用户想要什么，并进行人工审核。 这 107 条要求用于 §2.3 的意图度量。

paragraphs.en: A judge (GPT-5.6-terra) reads only the persona agent’s utterances and rates each of 11 profile dimensions as clearly expressed, weakly expressed, not expressed, or contradicted (Figure 6 , Table 8 ). Contradictions do not drive the drop: 11.1% of cells contain at least one, and removing them changes the mean Δ \Delta from − 0.248 -0.248 to − 0.249 -0.249 . Of the 329 contradictions across models, 168 are expert personas whose profile specifies that they want every detail but who request a brief answer. The profile is, however, expressed only in part: on average 15.4% of the dimensions are clearly expressed, and 66.8% of cells clearly express at least one. Accessibility and device are rated as not expressed in 95% and 82% of judgments.

paragraphs.en: All backbones run in the same Chrome harness with the same nine tools: open_tab , goto , read_page , click , type_text , list_tabs , close_tab , ask_user , and finish . The observation is page text. read_page returns the visible text followed by the page’s interactive fields and controls, each with a handle the agent can target. Screenshots are stored at every step for auditing but never enter the agent’s context. For REAL tasks the harness loads the prescribed initial state s 0 s_{0} before the episode and reads the final state s T s_{T} afterward. A further question beyond the budget of Q = 5 Q=5 is refused, and the agent is told to decide for itself. The episode ends when the agent calls finish . At the turn limit it receives one more prompt to summarize its findings. Appendix B.3 reports the API cost.
paragraphs.zh: 所有骨干模型都在同一个 Chrome 测试框架中运行，使用相同的九个工具：open_tab、goto、read_page、click、type_text、list_tabs、close_tab、ask_user 和 finish。 观测内容是页面文本。read_page 返回可见文本，其后是页面的可交互字段和控件，每个都带有一个智能体可以指定的句柄。 每一步都会存储截图以供审计，但绝不会进入智能体的上下文。 对于 REAL 任务，测试框架在回合开始前加载规定的初始状态 s 0 s_{0}，并在回合结束后读取最终状态 s T s_{T}。 超出 Q = 5 Q=5 预算的进一步提问会被拒绝，并告知智能体自行决定。 当智能体调用 finish 时，回合结束。 在达到轮次上限时，它会收到一次额外的提示，要求其总结自己的发现。 附录 B.3 报告了 API 成本。

paragraphs.en: For each cell we log tokens (including cached and reasoning tokens), monetary cost, wall-clock time, and step count, with judging cost kept separate from agent cost. Table 10 reports the API cost over the cells in the paper, using the latest scored run of each cell. We cost every agent backbone at its list price per million input and output tokens, without cache discounts, so that the backbones are comparable. Providers bill cached input at a discount, and 68% of all agent input tokens are cached, so the billed cost is lower than the list cost. Over the eight backbones with a list price, the agent costs 4,737 USD, or 1.60 USD per cell. The cost per cell ranges from 0.26 USD for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to 3.26 USD for Kimi K3 and follows the price per token more than the number of steps. paragraphs.en: We check the GPT-5.6-terra judgments against annotations from two human annotators, P1 and P2. The annotation set contains 22 tasks, with two representative tasks selected from each of the 11 domains. Each task is run with the four personas and the original request under all nine backbones, yielding 990 outputs with 3,960 requirements and 792 persona-agent dialogues with 11 profile dimensions each (8,712 dimensions). Each annotator reads only the user turns of the dialogue, the agent’s answer and trajectory, the rubric, and the profile. They were instructed not to read the GPT-5.6-terra labels, which are used only to compute agreement. For each requirement, they label whether the user raised it, whether the agent engaged with it, and whether it was met (§ 2.3 ). For each profile dimension, they rate the persona agent’s utterances as clearly expressed, weakly expressed, or not expressed, counting a contradiction as not expressed (Appendix A.4 ). The primary loss cause is not re-annotated. Table 11 gives the percent agreement with GPT-5.6-terra and Cohen’s κ \kappa , counting only items that GPT-5.6-terra labels; GPT-5.6-terra gives no raised or engaged label on the 315 REAL outputs.

paragraphs.en: The verified rating scores these stops against the original goal. At delivery the user sees the draft and a reply stating that nothing was sent, which is what it asked for, and 62% judge the task done. After verification it is also shown that the site did not change, while it still holds the original instruction x t x_{t} , which asks for the submission, and only 7% judge the task done. The verified rating therefore does not separate a stop the user asked for from a failure to act. We treat the rating at delivery as the measure of whether the user was served, and the verified rating as a check against the original goal.
paragraphs.zh: 经验证的评分将这些停止点与原始目标进行对照。 在交付时，用户看到草稿以及一条说明未发送任何内容的回复，这正是它所要求的，62%的智能体判断任务完成。 经过验证还表明网站没有发生变化，而它仍然保留着要求提交的原始指令 x_{t}，仅有7%的智能体判断任务完成。 因此，经验证的评分无法将用户要求的停止与未能行动区分开来。 我们将交付时的评分作为衡量用户是否得到服务的标准，而将经验证的评分作为对照原始目标的检验。

paragraphs.en: Task completion is scored against the original instruction, while a persona request may omit a requirement, add a constraint, or ask for a draft first (§ 3.3 ). The drop in Table 4 is therefore a drop in task completion on the original specification, and it combines failures of execution with changes in what the user asked for and with errors of the persona agent. The primary causes separate part of this mixture. In 11.2% of loss cells the agent stopped because the user asked it to, and in 17.1% the cell lost points only on requirements the user never raised, so 28.3% of loss cells reflect a changed or unstated request rather than a failure on what the user asked for. The persona agent gives wrong information in 1.5% of information and 4.1% of action loss cells (Table 20 ), and excluding the 11.1% of cells in which it contradicts its profile changes the mean Δ \Delta from − 0.248 -0.248 to − 0.249 -0.249 (Appendix A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 任务完成度是针对原始指令进行评分的，而角色设定请求可能省略某项要求、增加某个约束，或要求先给出草稿（§ 3.3）。 因此表 4 中的下降是针对原始规格说明的任务完成度下降，它把执行上的失败与用户所提需求的变化以及角色智能体的错误合并在一起。 主要原因分析拆分了这一混合因素中的一部分。 在 11.2% 的失分单元中，智能体停止是因为用户要求它停止；在 17.1% 的单元中，失分仅发生在用户从未提出的要求上，因此 28.3% 的失分单元反映的是需求被更改或未被说明，而不是智能体在用户所提需求上的失败。 角色智能体在 1.5% 的信息类失分单元和 4.1% 的行动类失分单元中给出了错误信息（表 20），并且排除其与自身设定相矛盾的 11.1% 的单元后，平均 Δ 从 −0.248 变为 −0.249（附录 A.4）。

paragraphs.en: Table 21 summarizes clarification and outcome reporting for each model, and Table 22 gives the details of clarification. On action tasks, agents ask in 78% of the cells in which the user asks to review first, mostly to confirm, in 16% of those in which the user asks only for help, and in 28% of those in which the user asks the agent to act. Agents ask more often on tasks whose original request also fails, 31% against 26% on action tasks and 7.5% against 2.9% on information tasks. When a question does target an omitted requirement, that requirement is eventually met in 10 of 33 cases on information tasks, against 61% for the same requirements in original-request cells, and in 14 of 20 cases on action tasks. The within-task difference between cells with and without a question is positive for four models and negative for five. In one typical failure, the agent asks which year is meant, all four personas answer 2025 or 2026 while the site contains data for 2024, and all four cells fail. The original request, in which no question is asked, passes.
paragraphs.zh: 表 21 总结了各模型的澄清与结果报告情况，表 22 给出了澄清的细节。 在操作类任务上，智能体在用户要求先审阅的单元格中 78% 的情况下会提问（主要是为了确认），在用户只寻求帮助的单元格中为 16%，在用户要求智能体执行操作的单元格中为 28%。 在原始请求本身也失败的任务上，智能体提问更频繁：操作类任务上为 31% 对 26%，信息类任务上为 7.5% 对 2.9%。 当问题确实针对某个被遗漏的需求时，该需求最终在信息类任务的 33 个案例中的 10 个里得到满足，而同样的需求在原始请求单元格中的满足率为 61%；在操作类任务上则是 20 个案例中的 14 个。 就同一任务内部而言，有提问单元格与无提问单元格之间的差异在四个模型上为正，在五个模型上为负。 在一个典型的失败案例中，智能体询问指的是哪一年，四个角色（persona）都回答 2025 或 2026，而网站中包含的是 2024 年的数据，结果四个单元格全部失败。 而未提出任何问题的原始请求则通过了。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 in § 5.1 shows the case of a practical user. Figures 11 to 13 follow one cell for each of the other three groups, two on action tasks for senior and young users and one on an information task for an expert user. Each figure shows the task and the user’s request, sampled browser views of the agent’s main steps, an excerpt of its final answer, and how the cell is scored. Together with Figure 4 , they show that the score and what the user wanted can diverge in both directions. A checker can fail an agent that stopped where the user asked it to (Figure 11 ) or pass one that left part of the original task undone (Figure 13 ), and on information tasks the rubric judge gives partial credit when the answer falls short of the synthesis or decision that was asked for (Figures 12 and 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: §5.1 中的图 4 展示了一个真实用户的案例。 图 11 至图 13 针对另外三组各采用一个单元格，其中两个是关于老年用户和年轻用户的操作任务，一个是关于专家用户的信息任务。 每幅图都展示了任务与用户的请求、智能体主要步骤的采样浏览器视图、其最终答案的节选，以及该单元格的评分方式。 结合图 4 来看，它们表明评分与用户想要的结果可能在两个方向上出现偏差。 检查器可能会判停在用户要求的位置的智能体为失败（图 11），也可能将通过的智能体遗留了原始任务的一部分未完成（图 13）；而在信息任务上，当答案未达到所要求的综合或决策水平时，评分细则裁判会给出部分得分（图 12 和图 4）。
